en.hubeali: (It has been narrated) raising it to Abu Abdullahasws having said that Rasool-Allahsaww complained to hissaww Lordazwj Mighty and Majestic of the back pain, so Heazwj Commanded him with the eating of the grains with the meat, meaning Al-Hareys’.
en.sarwar: 3. In another Hadith in a marfu‘ manner the following is narrated: “Abu ‘Abd Allah, Alayhi al-Salam,

has said that the Messenger of Allah, O Allah, grant compensation to Muhammad and his family worthy of their services to Your cause, complained before Allah, most Majestic, most Glorious, against back pain and He commanded him to eat grains with meat, that is, al-Harisah.”’
